description_en: Submit a diagnostic task for a single IoT card
kebab_example: aliyun iotcc submit-diagnose-task-for-single-card --iot-cloud-connector-id iotcc-smy9a5ockzp08n0000 --source-type '卡IP' --source 169.254.XX.XX --begin-time 1643077466 --end-time 1643077666 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitDiagnoseTaskForSingleCard

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud connector instance that runs the diagnostic task for a single IoT card
parameters.help_zh: 发起单张物联网卡网络诊断的实例ID
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_id

parameters.help_en:
The source type for the network diagnostic task. Valid values:

Card IP: Use the IP address assigned to the IoT card.

Card ID: Use the ID of the IoT card
parameters.help_zh:
网络诊断的源类型。取值：

卡IP：表示通过物联网卡的卡IP进行网络诊断。

卡ID：表示通过物联网卡的卡ID进行网络诊断
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en: The source IP address or ID of the IoT card
parameters.help_zh: 网络诊断的源端卡IP或者卡ID
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en:
The destination type for the network diagnostic task. Valid values:

IP: The destination is an IP address.

Domain Name: The destination is a domain name
parameters.help_zh:
网路诊断的目的类型。取值：

IP：表示诊断的目的类型是IP类型。

域名：表示诊断的目的类型是域名类型
parameters.name: destination_type

parameters.help_en: The destination IP address or domain name
parameters.help_zh: 网络诊断的目的IP或者域名
parameters.name: destination

parameters.help_en: The start timestamp of the diagnostic task, in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 网络诊断的开始时间戳。单位：秒
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en: The end timestamp of the diagnostic task, in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 网络诊断的结束时间戳。单位：秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The region ID where the diagnostic task runs.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
网络诊断所在的地域ID。


您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the cloud connector instance owner
parameters.help_zh: 云连接器实例使用者的阿里云账号ID
parameters.name: resource_uid

DiagnoseTaskId.description_en: The ID of the diagnostic task
